tips.title: Define post processor/machine
tips.body: Select a post processor/machine based on part requirements and availability.

tips.title: Set coordinate system for cylindrical parts
tips.body: Align the X axis with the axis of revolution and Z axis with depth.

tips.title: Define target part for machining
tips.body: Right-click Target in CAM tree manager and select the part.

tips.title: Add machine setup operation
tips.body: Right-click Operations > Machine setup > Add at start of operations tree.

tips.title: Add milling operation using Sim 5 Axis Milling
tips.body: Right-click Setup > Add Milling Operation > Sim 5 Axis Milling.

tips.title: Select parallel cuts technology
tips.body: In the Technology list, click Parallel cuts.

tips.title: Define geometry for tool path
tips.body: Click Geometry to define the area to be cut and other parameters.

tips.title: Select drive surface for tool path
tips.body: Click under Drive surface and select the highlighted face.

tips.title: Set work type for tool path
tips.body: Select the Work type (e.g., Around ‘X’ Axis, Around ‘Y’ Axis, Around ‘Z’ Axis).

tips.title: Choose tool path strategy
tips.body: Select the Constant option for parallel cuts, avoiding exact edges or starting/end at exact surface edges.

tips.title: Set tool path parameters
tips.body: Cut tolerance: 0.02, Distance: Not used, Maximum Step Over: 3.

tips.title: Define clearance area type
tips.body: Select Clearance to an Imaginary Cylinder with a radius of 65 mm and parallel to X axis.

tips.title: Create leads and links
tips.body: Clear Use default Lead-In/Out, enter parameters for entry and exit.

tips.title: Set tool axis control
tips.body: Enter a tilt angle of 25 degrees at the side of the cutting field.
